name: Player Contour Subtle White Rim
purpose: Separate enemy silhouette from dark background clutter in tactical engagement moments.
trigger_conditions: Enemy enters sightline from shadow or smoke edge
required_visual_conditions: Clear contrast difference between player model and background or tracked player matte.
required_masks_or_mattes: Luma keyer or edge detect bitmap mask.
recommended_color_palette: Crisp optical white (#f0f4f8) with soft feathered edge.
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> ChannelBooleans1 -> EdgeDetect1 (Sobel) -> ErodeDilate1 (Dilate: 1.5) -> FastGlow1 (Glow: 0.45) -> Merge1 (ApplyMode: Screen) onto MediaIn1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: Connect MediaIn1 to EdgeDetect node, filter out background luma, dilate edges, screen-composite over original.
qa_procedure: Verify outline does not bleed onto background walls; disable mask when enemy is heavily behind cover.
